plain_english_policy: This bill amends existing state law to authorize Lauderdale County's Community Development Commission (CDC) to provide uniforms and an annual allowance for sheriff's deputies, corrections officers, and other designated employees in the Sheriff's Office. The funding source is specified as a portion of 'TVA in-lieu-of-tax payments' collected by the county via its CDC fund. Crucially, this bill makes these provisions retroactive to October 1, 2006.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally obligate Lauderdale County's Community Development Commission to furnish uniforms and pay for their maintenance costs for specific law enforcement personnel within the Sheriff's Office. The financial burden is shifted from general county funds or other sources to a dedicated fund derived specifically from TVA in-lieu-of-tax payments.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsor (Representative Morrow) advanced legislation that codifies a specific funding mechanism for Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office uniforms using TVA in-lieu-of-tax revenue.
evidence_quotes: "Section 2. (a) The Lauderdale County Community Development Commission shall furnish each deputy sheriff, the chief deputy, each corrections officer, and any other employee designated by the sheriff with uniforms and an annual allowance sufficient to maintain the uniforms."

(b) Notwithstanding the provisions of Act 2008-125... the Lauderdale County Community Development Commission shall pay for the costs associated with this act from the Community Development Fund created by Act 2008-125 which is comprised of the additional three percent of TVA in-lieu-of-tax payments received pursuant to Section 40-28-2 of the Code of Alabama 1975, beginning with the fiscal year which began October 1, 2006."
"to provide that this act shall be retroactive to October 1, 2006."
